product.olivetti-snx-160-n.summary: The desktop SNX equipped to handle serial terminals and Ethernet traffic.
product.olivetti-snx-160-n.history: Olivetti retained the SNX 160/N name for the 133 and 166 MHz configurations of the Uranos platform.
product.olivetti-snx-160-n.architecture: It could concentrate serial connections from several terminals. The Stallion GO2175 ISA card supports up to 32 RS-232D channels through external boxes.
product.olivetti-snx-160-n.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160-n.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160-n.service-guide: Olivetti, SNX / NetStrada – Pocket Service Guide, ch. 10
